title: SessionIntentParams
description: Structured interactive intent from the pane controller. The helper runtime encodes it against modes the program set; this is never PTY bytes.

accessEpoch.description: Pane access epoch last observed by the controller. Refused access_revoked with zero bytes if it is no longer current.

payload.description: Key name with modifiers, committed UTF-8 text, or verbatim paste body.
